name: poco-dnssd
description: Poco DNSSD (pocoproject/poco-dnssd) with its Avahi backend, built as static libraries against vcpkg's poco[net]. Upstream ships only Poco's own make rules and Visual Studio projects, so this overlay port vendors a CMakeLists. Backs kythira's poco_peer_discovery (CONFIG_POCO_DISCOVERY), gated behind the opt-in "poco-dnssd" manifest feature. Needs the host's Avahi client headers (libavahi-client-dev on Debian/Ubuntu): vcpkg has no avahi port.
